observation: Delegates ambitious multi-file refactors confidently — approved a 31-file performance optimization plan without hesitation, trusting parallel agent execution
Cost-conscious about API usage — asked specifically about model hierarchy optimization to minimize token spend without compromising quality
Prefers 'commit and push everything' as a single command — wants all changes shipped immediately, not staged incrementally
Thinks in feedback loops — when told ideas have no rejection mechanism, immediately wanted to add one so Alfred could learn from the feedback
Values Alfred learning and improving autonomously — asked unprompted whether Alfred is still learning from conversations, showing investment in the system's growth
Communicates in brief directives — 'yes set it up', 'commit and push everything', 're-run the failed cron job'. Trusts Claude Code to fill in the details
